title: SPLK-1002 practice test
description: One practice test transcribed verbatim from the Udemy course, plus a guide layer mapping each question to the blueprint and flagging keys that disagree with the official documentation.

testId.description: Stable identifier, matches the filename without the extension.

id.description: Globally unique across all tests, for example t1-q23.

number.description: Question number as shown in the course.

type.description: single when the course marks one 'Correct answer'; multi when it marks one or more 'Correct selection'. Multi questions normally say 'Choose all that apply' in the stem.

overallExplanation.description: The course's 'Overall explanation' block, verbatim. null when the course gave none.

duplicateOf.description: Question id this one duplicates, for example 't1-q3'. The course's final test repeats 59 of its 65 questions from tests 1 to 4. A UI should offer to hide duplicates, and coverage stats should count unique questions.

courseKey.description: The option ids the Udemy course marked correct, preserved verbatim. isCorrect on each option holds the DOCUMENTATION-VERIFIED answer, which differs from this array wherever guide.keyVerdict is 'wrong'. Present on every fact-checked question.

id.description: Assigned A, B, C, ... in the order the course presents the options. The course itself does not letter them.

explanation.description: The course's per-option 'Explanation', verbatim. null when the course gave none, which is common from question 11 onward.

guide.description: Added by this study guide, not from the course.

blueprintSection.description: Official sub-objective, for example '5.2'. null when the question tests something not on the SPLK-1002 blueprint.

readNext.description: Repo-relative paths, optionally with a heading anchor.

keyVerdict.description: agree: the course key matches the docs. disputed: the docs do not settle it and sources disagree. wrong: the course key contradicts the docs. imprecise: the keyed answer is defensible but the question or its explanation is loosely worded.

verdictNote.description: Required whenever keyVerdict is not 'agree'. States what the course claims, what the docs say, and how to settle it.

resolveInLab.description: A concrete check to run on a local Splunk instance that would settle a disputed item.

correctedAnswer.description: Set only when keyVerdict is 'wrong'. The option ids that are actually correct. An empty array means no offered option is correct, so the question is unanswerable as printed.

docs.description: Official documentation for this question. The first entry is the primary page to open when reviewing the topic.

url.description: A help.splunk.com URL confirmed to return HTTP 200.

title.description: Page title plus manual and version, for example 'transaction command (Search Reference 10.4)'.

note.description: What specifically to read on that page to settle this question.

factChecked.description: True once the question's keyed answer and the course's explanation have both been checked against fetched documentation.

explanationIssues.description: False or misleading statements found in the course's overallExplanation or per-option explanations, each with the correction. Empty when the explanation text is sound.
